ambient_notes.text: In regiment, LAWS.bend defines literal_conservation_law and partition_completeness_law for eng3 in stage 18.
The transition_component_build_status interface of whiteboard takes graph, component_id, and new_status.
The regiment module exposes the extract_structured_table_rows interface taking doc_tables and returning table_records.
The whiteboard module exposes the compile_laws_bend interface taking scope_id and law_records and returning laws_bend_text.

Charter [lattice_core]: Architecture memory, focused code lookup, and pre-commit verification engine for AI coding agents — making the Lattice itself the living specification so design and code stay in sync automatically. | Principles: Zero LLM calls and zero third-party runtime dependencies (<50ms deterministic execution); 1-hop bounded context slices (<2KB); readable, unpacked modules with zero semicolon packing; Bend 2 formal equational proofs and AST pre-commit enforcement.

The runtime_foundation component sends McpJsonRpcRequest to the_executive.
